name: Git Particle Collider
description: Repositories become particle sources whose animated collisions illuminate a contribution detector grid.
author: AIAI Laboratory

theme.description: Auto follows the viewer color scheme; dark and light force a fixed appearance.

accent.description: Collision core, experiment label and primary highlight color.

particleA.description: First beam, detector and primary particle color.

particleB.description: Secondary particle and collision ray color.

particleC.description: Opposing beam and third particle color.
